evidence_policy: Complete written proofs, conjectures, adjacent counterexamples, and finite-only evidence are separate. No catalog resolution ledger is changed.

definitions.C: C_r(0,0)=1, C_r(n,k)=0 outside 0<=k<=n; C_r(n,k)=(n+(r-1)k-1)_(r-1) C_r(n-1,k-1)+(n+(r-1)k-1) C_r(n-1,k). Falling factorial.
definitions.S: S_r(0,0)=1, S_r(n,k)=0 outside 0<=k<=n; S_r(n,k)=binom(n+(r-1)k-1,r-1) S_r(n-1,k-1)+k S_r(n-1,k).
definitions.hankel_minor: det(f_(i_a+j_b)(x)) with finite strictly increasing lists I,J of nonnegative integers, equal cardinality.
definitions.coefficientwise_positive_on_support: Every nonzero coefficient is strictly positive; no missing degree within the specified support interval.

proved_results.name: First principal cycle Hankel determinant
proved_results.statement: For every integer r>=2, det(c_r,i+j(x))_(i,j=0)^2 has support exactly {2,3,4,5,6} and strictly positive coefficients at each of those degrees.
proved_results.proof: REPORT.md: normalization, explicit coefficient expansion and factorial-ratio inequalities; highest coefficient is a positive gamma-product Gram determinant.
proved_results.recovery: Independently reconstructed from a user-reported lead; stalled continuation artifacts unavailable.
proved_results.limitations: One principal minor; does not prove arbitrary 3x3 or larger Hankel positivity. Publication priority unclaimed. Parent mathematical review and independent symbolic/exact checks completed; see ../audit/PROOF-REVIEW.md.

proved_results.name: Leading 3x3 cycle block
proved_results.statement: For every integer r>=2, every nonempty minor of the leading block (c_r,i+j(x))_(i,j=0)^2 is coefficientwise nonnegative and strictly positive throughout its specified nonzero support.
proved_results.proof: REPORT.md corollary gives every distinct 2x2 polynomial explicitly, using the same factorial-ratio inequalities and gamma-product moment minors; 1x1 and 3x3 cases are supplied.
proved_results.limitations: Leading indices 0,1,2 only; no arbitrary index-set conclusion. Parent mathematical review and independent symbolic/exact checks completed; see ../audit/PROOF-REVIEW.md.

conjectures_and_recovery_targets.name: Universal Hankel TN2, both families
conjectures_and_recovery_targets.statement: For every integer r>=1, every 2x2 minor det(f_(i_a+j_b)(x)) with 0<=i_1<i_2 and 0<=j_1<j_2 has nonnegative coefficients, for f=c_r or f=s_r.
conjectures_and_recovery_targets.evidence: User's interrupted agent asserted a proof; those files are unavailable. Reconstructed finite checks cover 23328 minors for r in {1,2,3,4,5,6,8,11,16}, I,J subset {0,...,8}; all passed. Cycle leading 3x3 block is proved separately.
conjectures_and_recovery_targets.status: unverified lead; not recovered as a proof
conjectures_and_recovery_targets.novelty: Cycle part is an order-two subproblem of existing Q1160. The all-r subset version is a separately tracked adjacent question, compatible with the known order-three failures.
conjectures_and_recovery_targets.exact_equivalent_form: It suffices to prove f_m(x) f_(n+1)(x)-f_(m+1)(x) f_n(x) >=_coeff 0 for every 0<=m<n. Any larger-gap 2x2 determinant is a telescoping sum of such expressions at fixed total index; this equivalence does not divide polynomials.
conjectures_and_recovery_targets.next_step: Recover or derive a two-object injection or coefficientwise telescoping recurrence. Triangle TN2 concerns C_r/S_r entries and does not establish this Hankel statement.

conjectures_and_recovery_targets.name: Arbitrary cycle Hankel minors of order three
conjectures_and_recovery_targets.statement: For every integer r>=3 and every pair of increasing nonnegative triples I,J, det(c_r,i_a+j_b(x)) has nonnegative coefficients.
conjectures_and_recovery_targets.evidence: Exact first principal minor and entire leading 3x3 block now have an all-r proof; the initial report gives positive extreme coefficients for every cycle Hankel minor.
conjectures_and_recovery_targets.novelty: Research direction within the existing question, not a new independent catalog statement.
conjectures_and_recovery_targets.next_step: Start with I=J=(1,2,3), then unequal index gaps; derive formulas in rising factorials rather than infer a theorem by increasing a cutoff.

counterexamples_and_obstructions.statement: The subset minor I=(1,2,3), J=(0,1,2) has negative x^5 coefficient for every integer r>=3, as proved in the initial packet. At r=3 its polynomial is -16x^5+19110x^6+938700x^7+15309000x^8+79380000x^9.
counterexamples_and_obstructions.scope: Subset Hankel positivity of order three; does not refute cycle Q1160 or Hankel TN2 conjecture C001.
